item.about: Former SUS-listed student association on cryptocurrencies and blockchain; later renamed Bitcoinstudenter Stockholm. Public sources indicate the association was closed (chair Ammy Edberg announced closing the chapter, Nov 2025).
item.activity: No dated activity in the last 12 months found on the SUS association page (404 as of 2026-11-09). LinkedIn history shows a 2024 name change; association reported closed Nov 2025.
item.name: Bitcoinstudenter Stockholm (formerly Crypto Students Stockholm / Kryptostudenter Stockholm)
